## Overview Adds **NIXL EP v2** as the MoE all2all backend `nixl_ep_v2`. **One kernel pair** serves NVLink and RDMA, and NIXL lets peers join and leave at runtime, so it supports **elastic EP without a restart**. Across NVLink domains it is **up to 59% faster** than `nixl_ep` and **10-16% faster** than `deepep_v2`. Resizes have **29-55% less downtime** than with `nixl_ep`. **Status:** draft, work in progress; the NIXL change it builds on is also a draft, and both may still change. **Depends on:** NIXL [`6485f7a5`](https://github.com/lishapira/nixl/commit/6485f7a5f5fb896c6bc5d02bc2a975746739c66d), which adds the kernels as `nixl.runtime.ep` (not in `ai-dynamo/nixl` yet). **Related backends:** - `deepep_v2` ([#41183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/41183)): no in-place resize; elastic EP tears down and rebuilds its buffer and CUDA graphs. - `nixl_ep` ([#35627](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/35627)): keeps its graphs, but has only low-latency kernels. ## Claims - **Unified NVLink + RDMA kernels:** one dispatch/combine pair covers NVLink and RDMA in the same call. - **NIXL transport:** peers connect and disconnect at runtime, with no fixed world or global communicator to rebuild. - **Elastic EP:** resizes without a restart. - **CUDA graphs:** remaining ranks keep their buffer and graphs across a resize. - **Precisions:** BF16, block FP8, NVFP4. - **Performance:** - vs `nixl_ep`: up to 14% higher throughput on one NVLink domain, up to 59% across domains. - vs `deepep_v2`: 10-16% faster across domains. - Elastic EP: 29-55% less downtime than `nixl_ep`. ## Performance ### End-to-end serving DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 on GB200, 1K input / 1K output tokens, disaggregated prefill and decode. Throughput is aggregate output tokens/s across all decode GPUs. DeepEPv2 and NIXL EPv2 both run on 26 SMs, for a fair comparison; DeepEPv2's SM count comes from a `deepep_v2` setting that is not part of this PR.

## Overview Adds **NIXL EP v2** as the MoE all2all backend `nixl_ep_v2`. **One kernel pair** serves NVLink and RDMA, and NIXL lets peers join and leave at runtime, so it supports **elastic EP without a restart**. Across NVLink domains it is **up to 59% faster** than `nixl_ep` and **10-16% faster** than `deepep_v2`. Resizes have **29-55% less downtime** than with `nixl_ep`. **Status:** draft, work in progress; the NIXL change it builds on is also a draft, and both may still change. **Depends on:** NIXL [`6485f7a5`](https://github.com/lishapira/nixl/commit/6485f7a5f5fb896c6bc5d02bc2a975746739c66d), which adds the kernels as `nixl.runtime.ep` (not in `ai-dynamo/nixl` yet). **Related backends:** - `deepep_v2` ([#41183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/41183)): no in-place resize; elastic EP tears down and rebuilds its buffer and CUDA graphs. - `nixl_ep` ([#35627](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/35627)): keeps its graphs, but has only low-latency kernels. ## Claims - **Unified NVLink + RDMA kernels:** one dispatch/combine pair covers NVLink and RDMA in the same call. - **NIXL transport:** peers connect and disconnect at runtime, with no fixed world or global communicator to rebuild. - **Elastic EP:** resizes without a restart. - **CUDA graphs:** remaining ranks keep their buffer and graphs across a resize. - **Precisions:** BF16, block FP8, NVFP4. - **Performance:** - vs `nixl_ep`: up to 14% higher throughput on one NVLink domain, up to 59% across domains. - vs `deepep_v2`: 10-16% faster across domains. - Elastic EP: 29-55% less downtime than `nixl_ep`. ## Performance ### End-to-end serving DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 on GB200, 1K input / 1K output tokens, disaggregated prefill and decode. Throughput is aggregate output tokens/s across all decode GPUs. DeepEPv2 and NIXL EPv2 both run on 26 SMs, for a fair comparison; DeepEPv2's SM count comes from a `deepep_v2` setting that is not part of this PR.

Commands ```bash pytest tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_envs.py ```
## Details ### Why - `deepep_v2`: no in-place resize; elastic EP tears down and rebuilds its buffer and CUDA graphs. - `nixl_ep`: keeps its graphs across a resize, but has only low-latency kernels. - `nixl_ep_v2`: keeps its graphs, and has NIXL EP v2's kernels for both decode and prefill. - Throughput vs `nixl_ep`: up to 14% higher on one NVLink domain, up to 59% higher across domains. - Across domains, 10-16% faster than `deepep_v2`. - Elastic EP: 29-55% less downtime per resize than `nixl_ep`.
Design - **Manager:** one buffer per process, sized for the max EP size and shared by all MoE layers; no NCCL bootstrap. - **Prepare-finalize:** a new class with standard activation format, async support and a reduced combine output. - **Receive layouts:** exact in eager mode; padded or expanded under CUDA graphs. - **Wire precision:** BF16 → BF16; block FP8 → FP8; NVFP4 → BF16 (NVFP4 with opt-in dispatch). - **Elastic EP:** new ranks connect while serving goes on; the topology commits during the pause.
Changes by area - **Backend:** manager, prepare-finalize and Triton kernel, factory and config wiring, six env vars, an availability check; one-line opt-ins in shared MoE and elastic EP code. - **Elastic EP:** buffer and graph reuse on resize; the manager raises on a size the kernels cannot run. - **Shared code:** the FlashInfer NVFP4 top-k fix, the modular-kernel test-tool fix, the warm-up of new elastic EP communicators moved to the commit, with the engine paused, on every platform (as ROCm already does), and their peers connected before the pause, a wait for the engines a scale-down removed to exit before the next scale, expert maps of reused CUDA graphs kept alive, a helper that builds expert ids for the expanded receive layout. - **Tests:** three new kernel test files; the backend's cases in the MoE layer, modular-kernel and FlashInfer tests, with a fake-buffer helper; tests for the NVFP4 fix, the helper, the removed-engine wait and the NCCL setting helper; elastic EP test; four GSM8K configs. - **Docs:** one row in the expert parallel deployment guide.
### Install - Install NIXL with NIXL EP v2, at [`6485f7a5`](https://github.com/lishapira/nixl/commit/6485f7a5f5fb896c6bc5d02bc2a975746739c66d) (branch `nixl_ep_v2`), into vLLM's environment, either: - as a wheel: [`contrib/build-wheel.sh`](https://github.com/lishapira/nixl/blob/6485f7a5f5fb896c6bc5d02bc2a975746739c66d/contrib/build-wheel.sh) `--build-nixl-ep --torch-versions `, then `pip install`; or - from source: see NIXL EP v2's [README](https://github.com/lishapira/nixl/blob/6485f7a5f5fb896c6bc5d02bc2a975746739c66d/runtime/ep/README.md) (requirements, getting started). - First start is slow on a cold cache: the kernels JIT-compile during warm-up, cached in `~/.nixl_ep_v2` (`NIXL_EP_JIT_CACHE_DIR` overrides it). ### Usage ```bash vllm serve --data-parallel-size --enable-expert-parallel --all2all-backend nixl_ep_v2 ``` - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE` (default 0: NIXL finds the domains; under elastic EP, one domain): GPUs per NVLink domain. Set it when a job spans more than one domain; every multi-domain result here set it. - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NUM_SMS` (default 0: the buffer's launch grid): SMs per dispatch and combine. - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_EXPAND` (default 0): under CUDA graphs, the expanded receive layout instead of the padded one. - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NVFP4_DISPATCH` (default 0): opt-in NVFP4 dispatch. - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_PREFER_OVERLAP` (default 1): buffer flag `prefer_overlap_with_compute`. - `VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_ALLOW_MULTIPLE_REDUCTION` (default 1): buffer flag `allow_multiple_reduction`. - Elastic EP: add `--enable-elastic-ep --elastic-ep-max-dp-size --enable-eplb --data-parallel-backend ray`. ### Not yet done - [ ] No DBO (dual-batch overlap): nothing refuses `--enable-dbo` with `nixl_ep_v2` yet. ---

+def _nixl_ep_v2_manager_worker(
+    pgi: ProcessGroupInfo,
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+    cpu_group,
+    domain_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.all2all import (
+        NixlEPV2All2AllManager,

+    world = pgi.world_size
+    comm = get_ep_group().device_communicator

+    assert mgr.max_sms_used() is None  # no buffer yet
+    kw = dict(

+        hidden=2048,
+        num_topk=2,
+        use_fp8_dispatch=False,
+        num_local_experts=4,
+    )
+    if 0 < domain_size < world:
+        # Domains smaller than the node's NVLink domain: every rank refuses.
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="smaller than the NVLink domain"):
+            mgr.get_handle(kw)
+        return
+    buf = mgr.get_handle(kw)
+    assert buf.rank_idx in buf.get_active_ranks()
+    assert mgr.max_num_ep_ranks == world
+    assert mgr.max_sms_used() == buf.num_launch_sms
+    if domain_size == 0:
+        # All GPUs of one node share one NVLink domain: direct mode.
+        assert buf.get_topology_ranks() == (1, world)
+        assert buf.get_topology() == ("direct", buf.num_launch_sms)
+    else:
+        # Declared domains: each EP rank sits at (domain, position) =
+        # divmod(rank, domain_size), and only hybrid mode spans several.

+    pgi: ProcessGroupInfo,
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig,

+    skewed: bool,

+    num_local_experts, hidden, topk = 4, 256, 2
+    num_tokens = [5, 3]  # per rank; the bucket is the largest's power of two
+    # Every rank draws the whole routing, so it knows what it receives.
+    # Skewed: every token picks rank 0's experts, so rank 1 receives nothing.
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    num_choices = num_local_experts * (1 if skewed else world)
+    all_ids = [
+        torch.stack([torch.randperm(num_choices, generator=gen, device="cpu")[:topk]
+                     for _ in range(n)])
+        for n in num_tokens
+    ]  # fmt: skip
+    owner = torch.cat(all_ids).long() // num_local_experts
+    num_recv_slots = int((owner == rank).sum())
+    num_recv_tokens = int((owner == rank).any(dim=1).sum())
+
+    mgr = get_ep_group().device_communicator.all2all_manager
+    buffer = mgr.get_handle(
+        dict(
+            num_max_tokens_per_rank=16,
+            hidden=hidden,

+            num_local_experts=num_local_experts,

+        buffer,
+        num_dispatchers=world,
+        rank_expert_offset=rank * num_local_experts,
+        num_sms=mgr.num_sms,
+        use_cudagraph=use_cudagraph,
+        expand=expand,
+    )
+    # NVFP4 with a fixed global scale and linear scale factors, so the test
+    # can dequantize them.
+    gscale = torch.tensor([448.0 * 6.0 / 8.0], device=device)
+    quant_config = {
+        None: FusedMoEQuantConfig.make(),
+        "fp8": FusedMoEQuantConfig.make(
+            current_platform.fp8_dtype(), block_shape=[128, 128]
+        ),
+        "nvfp4": FusedMoEQuantConfig.make(
+            "nvfp4", a1_gscale=gscale, is_scale_swizzled=False
+        ),
+    }[quant]
+    a1 = torch.randn(num_tokens[rank], hidden, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    topk_ids = all_ids[rank].long().to(device)
+    topk_weights = torch.rand(num_tokens[rank], topk, device=device)
+    with set_forward_context(
+        None,
+        vllm_config,
+        num_tokens=num_tokens[rank],
+        num_tokens_across_dp=torch.tensor(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int),
+    ):
+        x, x_scale, meta, ids, weights = pf.prepare(
+            a1,
+            topk_weights,
+            topk_ids,
+            num_local_experts * world,
+            None,
+            False,
+            quant_config,
+        )
+        if quant == "fp8":  # dequantize the 128-wide blocks
+            x = x.float().view(len(x), hidden // 128, 128) * x_scale.unsqueeze(-1)
+            x = x.view(len(x), hidden)
+        elif quant == "nvfp4" and len(x):  # quantized after receive
+            assert x.dtype == torch.uint8 and x.size(1) == hidden // 2
+            x = dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype(
+                x, x_scale, gscale, torch.float32, device, is_sf_linear_layout=True
+            )

+        local = (ids >= rank * num_local_experts) & (
+            ids < (rank + 1) * num_local_experts
+        )
+        if use_cudagraph and expand:
+            # Expanded for the worst case: the padded rows times
+            # min(topk, local experts), grouped by expert.
+            assert len(x) == next_power_of_2(max(num_tokens)) * world * min(
+                topk, num_local_experts
+            )
+            assert meta.expert_num_tokens is None
+            assert int(meta.psum_recv_per_rank[-1]) == num_recv_slots
+            assert (ids[num_recv_slots:] == -1).all()
+            x[num_recv_slots:] = 0  # uninitialized padding rows
+            assert local[:num_recv_slots].all()
+            assert (ids[:num_recv_slots].diff(dim=0) >= 0).all()
+        elif use_cudagraph:
+            # Padded: one row per token, the bucket for the maximum world.
+            assert len(x) == next_power_of_2(max(num_tokens)) * world
+            assert meta.expert_num_tokens is None
+            assert int(meta.psum_recv_per_rank[-1]) == num_recv_tokens
+            assert (ids[num_recv_tokens:] == -1).all()
+            x[num_recv_tokens:] = 0  # uninitialized padding rows
+            assert int(local[:num_recv_tokens].sum()) == num_recv_slots
+            assert ((ids == -1) | local).all()
+        else:
+            # Exact: one row per (token, local expert), grouped by expert.
+            assert len(x) == num_recv_slots == int(meta.expert_num_tokens.sum())
+            assert len(meta.expert_num_tokens) == num_local_experts
+            assert local.all() and (ids.diff(dim=0) >= 0).all()
+        # Experts that return each row times its local weights.
+        out = (x * (weights * local).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        output = torch.empty_like(a1)
+        pf.finalize_async(output, out, weights, ids, False, TopKWeightAndReduceNoOP())()

+    assert buffer.get_topology()[1] == mgr.max_sms_used()
+
+    if quant == "fp8":
+        q, scale = moe_kernel_quantize_input(
+            a1, None, current_platform.fp8_dtype(), False, [128, 128], False
+        )
+        a1 = q.float().view(len(q), hidden // 128, 128) * scale.unsqueeze(-1)
+        a1 = a1.view(len(q), hidden)
+    elif quant == "nvfp4":
+        q, scale = moe_kernel_quantize_input(a1, gscale, "nvfp4", False, None, False)
+        a1 = dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype(
+            q, scale, gscale, torch.float32, device, is_sf_linear_layout=True
+        )
+    expected = (a1.float() * topk_weights.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)).to(torch.bfloat16)

+    # must not set it at all (a joining rank would disagree with its peers).

+        inside = os.environ.get("NCCL_RUNTIME_CONNECT")
+    assert inside == ("0" if has_no_cache else None)
+    assert "NCCL_RUNTIME_CONNECT" not in os.environ

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_elastic_ep_scale_waits_for_removed_engines():
+    """A scale right after a scale-down waits for the removed engines'
+    shutdown, and gives up with an error if they never finish."""
+    client = object.__new__(DPLBAsyncMPClient)
+    client.eep_scaling_cache = object()
+
+    async def finish_shutdown():
+        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
+        client.eep_scaling_cache = None
+
+    shutdown = asyncio.create_task(finish_shutdown())
+    await client._wait_for_scale_down_cleanup(timeout_s=5)
+    assert shutdown.done()
+
+    client.eep_scaling_cache = object()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="did not shut down"):
+        await client._wait_for_scale_down_cleanup(timeout_s=0.2)

+@dataclass
+class _NixlEPV2State:
+    buffer: Any
+    kwargs: dict[str, Any]  # built for these get_handle() args; later calls must match
+    max_num_ep_ranks: int
+    num_sms: int  # active SMs per dispatch
+    elastic: bool = False  # elastic EP: the newest manager tears down

+def _wait_for_peers(store: Any, ranks: list[int], prefix: str) -> None:
+    """Wait for ranks' published nixl_ep_v2 metadata; the Store's wait
+    releases the GIL, so serving goes on."""
+    store.wait([f"{prefix}/{r}" for r in ranks], timedelta(seconds=300))
+

+def _nixl_ep_v2_num_sms(num_launch_sms: int) -> int:
+    """The active SMs per dispatch and combine.
+
+    Args:
+        num_launch_sms: The buffer's fixed launch grid.
+
+    Returns:
+        VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NUM_SMS, or the launch grid when it is 0.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NUM_SMS is not an even number from 2
+            to the launch grid, which nixl_ep_v2 would silently clamp.
+
+    """
+    num_sms = envs.VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NUM_SMS
+    if not num_sms:
+        return num_launch_sms
+    if num_sms % 2 or not 2 <= num_sms <= num_launch_sms:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"nixl_ep_v2: VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_NUM_SMS={num_sms} must be an even "
+            f"number from 2 to the launch grid of {num_launch_sms} SMs, or 0"
+        )
+    return num_sms
+
+
+def _nixl_ep_v2_world_args(
+    rank: int, ep_size: int, max_ep_size: int, domain_size: int
+) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """ElasticBuffer arguments that place EP rank `rank` in the maximum world.
+
+    With domain size 0, nixl_ep_v2 infers the domains from the starting ranks
+    and sizes the buffer for them. Otherwise the maximum world is
+    max_ep_size // domain_size NVLink domains of domain_size GPUs, and EP rank
+    `rank` sits in domain rank // domain_size at position rank % domain_size,
+    which is nixl_ep_v2's dense rank order.
+
+    Args:
+        rank: This GPU's EP rank.
+        ep_size: The starting EP size (the ranks that build the buffer).
+        max_ep_size: The largest EP size the job can reach.
+        domain_size: GPUs per NVLink domain; 0 to let nixl_ep_v2 infer it.
+
+    Returns:
+        {} for domain size 0. Otherwise max_num_scaleout_ranks,
+        max_num_scaleup_ranks, scaleout_rank_idx, scaleup_rank_idx and
+        num_group_scaleup_ranks for the ElasticBuffer constructor.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If max_ep_size is not whole domains, or ep_size is larger
+            than one domain but not whole domains.
+
+    """
+    if not domain_size:
+        return {}
+    if max_ep_size % domain_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"nixl_ep_v2: the max EP size {max_ep_size} is not a whole number "
+            f"of NVLink domains of {domain_size} GPUs; set "
+            "VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE to the GPUs per domain"
+        )
+    # nixl_ep_v2 builds the buffer only in whole domains, or in part of the
+    # first one.
+    if ep_size > domain_size and ep_size % domain_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"nixl_ep_v2: the starting EP size {ep_size} must fit in one NVLink "
+            f"domain of {domain_size} GPUs or fill whole domains"
+        )
+    return dict(
+        max_num_scaleout_ranks=max_ep_size // domain_size,
+        max_num_scaleup_ranks=domain_size,
+        scaleout_rank_idx=rank // domain_size,
+        scaleup_rank_idx=rank % domain_size,
+        num_group_scaleup_ranks=min(domain_size, ep_size),
+    )
+
+
+def nixl_ep_v2_max_ep_size(parallel_config: ParallelConfig) -> int:
+    """The largest EP size the job can reach.
+
+    The EP group spans the TP x PCP GPUs of every DP rank; elastic_ep_max_dp_size
+    is the DP size when elastic EP is off.
+
+    Args:
+        parallel_config: The job's parallel config.
+
+    Returns:
+        TP x PCP x the maximum DP size.
+
+    """
+    return (
+        parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
+        * parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size
+        * parallel_config.elastic_ep_max_dp_size
+    )
+
+
+def nixl_ep_v2_domain_size(parallel_config: ParallelConfig) -> int:
+    """GPUs per NVLink domain for nixl_ep_v2.
+
+    Args:
+        parallel_config: The job's parallel config.
+
+    Returns:
+        VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE if set, capped at the maximum EP size (a
+        larger domain holds the whole job). Otherwise 0 for a fixed EP size,
+        which lets nixl_ep_v2 infer the domains, and the maximum EP size under
+        elastic EP, which puts the whole maximum world in one domain.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE is negative, or under
+            elastic EP the domains break nixl_ep_v2's caps (at most 128 GPUs
+            per domain and 32 domains) or do not hold whole DP engines.
+
+    """
+    domain_size = envs.VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE
+    if domain_size < 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE must be 0 or positive, got {domain_size}"
+        )
+    max_ep_size = nixl_ep_v2_max_ep_size(parallel_config)
+    if domain_size:
+        domain_size = min(domain_size, max_ep_size)
+    elif parallel_config.enable_elastic_ep:
+        domain_size = max_ep_size
+    if parallel_config.enable_elastic_ep and (
+        domain_size > 128
+        or max_ep_size // domain_size > 32
+        or domain_size % parallel_config.world_size
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"nixl_ep_v2: elastic EP needs NVLink domains of at most 128 GPUs, "
+            f"at most 32 of them, each holding whole DP engines of "
+            f"{parallel_config.world_size} GPUs; got domains of {domain_size} "
+            f"GPUs for a max EP size of {max_ep_size}. Set "
+            "VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE"
+        )
+    return domain_size

+class NixlEPV2All2AllManager(All2AllManagerBase):
+    """All2All communication based on NIXL EP v2 (nixl.runtime.ep): the
+    topology-adaptive EP kernels on NIXL.
+
+    One ElasticBuffer per process, sized for the maximum EP size, serves every
+    MoE layer and is kept when elastic EP re-creates the manager.
+
+    Args:
+        cpu_group: The EP group's CPU process group.
+        tcp_store_group: The Store group for the NIXL bootstrap; elastic EP
+            passes its own. None builds one over the cpu_group's Store.
+
+    """
+
+    _state: _NixlEPV2State | None = None
+    _newest: "NixlEPV2All2AllManager | None" = None  # owns the teardown
+    _lock = threading.RLock()
+    _PREFIX = "nixl_ep_v2"  # publish / connect_ranks key prefix
+
+    def __init__(self, cpu_group, tcp_store_group=None):
+        assert has_nixl_ep_v2(), (
+            "nixl_ep_v2 needs nixl.runtime.ep: install a NIXL build with "
+            "NIXL EP v2 for this PyTorch version (see the warning above if it "
+            "was found but failed to import)."
+        )
+        if tcp_store_group is None:
+            tcp_store_group = StatelessProcessGroup(
+                rank=cpu_group.rank(),
+                world_size=cpu_group.size(),
+                store=dist.PrefixStore("nixl_ep_v2", cpu_group.get_group_store()),
+            )
+        super().__init__(cpu_group, tcp_store_group)
+        NixlEPV2All2AllManager._newest = self
+
+    @property
+    def max_num_ep_ranks(self) -> int:
+        """The largest EP size the buffer is sized for; set by the first
+        get_handle() call."""
+        assert NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state is not None
+        return NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state.max_num_ep_ranks
+
+    def get_handle(self, kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+        """The process's ElasticBuffer, built on the first call.
+
+        Args:
+            kwargs: num_max_tokens_per_rank, hidden, num_topk, use_fp8_dispatch
+                and num_local_experts; every call must pass equal kwargs.
+
+        Returns:
+            The nixl_ep_v2 ElasticBuffer shared by every MoE layer.
+
+        Raises:
+            AssertionError: If kwargs differ from the first call's.
+
+        """
+        with NixlEPV2All2AllManager._lock:
+            if NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state is None:
+                t0 = time.perf_counter()
+                NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state = self._make_state(kwargs)
+                logger.info(
+                    "nixl_ep_v2 build %d %s: build_s=%.3f",
+                    self.world_size,
+                    self._mode(self.world_size),
+                    time.perf_counter() - t0,
+                )
+            state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+            # One buffer serves every MoE layer, so every layer must ask for
+            # the same sizes.
+            assert kwargs == state.kwargs, (
+                f"nixl_ep_v2 buffer was built for {state.kwargs}, got {kwargs}"
+            )
+            return state.buffer
+
+    def _make_state(self, kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> _NixlEPV2State:
+        from nixl.runtime.ep import ElasticBuffer  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+        from nixl.runtime.ep.utils.nixl_bootstrap import (  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
+            NixlBootstrap,
+        )
+
+        parallel_config = get_current_vllm_config().parallel_config
+        max_num_ep_ranks = nixl_ep_v2_max_ep_size(parallel_config)
+        domain_size = nixl_ep_v2_domain_size(parallel_config)
+        sizing = dict(
+            num_max_tokens_per_rank=kwargs["num_max_tokens_per_rank"],
+            hidden=kwargs["hidden"],
+            num_topk=kwargs["num_topk"],
+            use_fp8_dispatch=kwargs["use_fp8_dispatch"],
+            num_experts_per_rank=kwargs["num_local_experts"],
+            prefer_overlap_with_compute=envs.VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_PREFER_OVERLAP,
+            allow_multiple_reduction=envs.VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_ALLOW_MULTIPLE_REDUCTION,
+            explicitly_destroy=True,
+        )
+        if envs.VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH:
+            return self._make_joiner_state(
+                ElasticBuffer, kwargs, sizing, max_num_ep_ranks, domain_size
+            )
+        if 0 < domain_size < self.world_size:
+            # A domain smaller than the NVLink domain makes nixl_ep_v2 treat
+            # NVLink neighbours as remote and send to them the scale-out
+            # (RDMA) way, but UCX carries that traffic over NVLink (cuda_ipc),
+            # where the kernels' flag-after-payload ordering does not hold:
+            # corrupted tokens or hangs. Allow it again once nixl_ep_v2 fixes
+            # it. Every rank gets the same records, so all raise together.
+            nvlink_domain_size = NixlBootstrap(
+                self.tcp_store_group.store,
+                self.rank,
+                self.world_size,
+                namespace="nixl_ep_v2/nvlink_domain",
+            ).num_scaleup_ranks
+            if domain_size < nvlink_domain_size:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"nixl_ep_v2: VLLM_NIXL_EP_V2_DOMAIN_SIZE={domain_size} is "
+                    f"smaller than the NVLink domain of {nvlink_domain_size} "
+                    "GPUs; set it to that or 0. A smaller domain sends NVLink "
+                    "traffic the RDMA way, which can corrupt tokens or hang."
+                )
+        world = _nixl_ep_v2_world_args(
+            self.rank, self.world_size, max_num_ep_ranks, domain_size
+        )
+        buffer = ElasticBuffer(
+            rank_idx=self.rank,
+            num_ranks=self.world_size,
+            store=self.tcp_store_group.store,
+            bootstrap_id="nixl_ep_v2",
+            **sizing,
+            **world,
+        )
+        return _NixlEPV2State(
+            buffer,
+            dict(kwargs),
+            max_num_ep_ranks,
+            _nixl_ep_v2_num_sms(buffer.num_launch_sms),
+            parallel_config.enable_elastic_ep,
+        )
+
+    def _make_joiner_state(
+        self,
+        buffer_cls: Any,
+        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        sizing: dict[str, Any],
+        max_num_ep_ranks: int,
+        domain_size: int,
+    ) -> _NixlEPV2State:
+        """Build a joining rank's buffer and connect it to every other rank.
+
+        The joiner builds a one-rank cohort at its own place in the maximum
+        world (a cohort of one accepts no num_group_scaleup_ranks), so it is
+        alone live: its warm-up touches no peer. commit_ep_size makes the new
+        world live once the existing ranks commit it.
+        """
+        world = _nixl_ep_v2_world_args(
+            self.rank, self.world_size, max_num_ep_ranks, domain_size
+        )
+        del world["num_group_scaleup_ranks"]
+        store = self.tcp_store_group.store
+        buffer = buffer_cls(
+            rank_idx=0,
+            num_ranks=1,
+            store=store,
+            bootstrap_id=f"{self._PREFIX}/join/{self.rank}",
+            connect_group=False,
+            **sizing,
+            **world,
+        )
+        buffer.publish(store=store, key_prefix=self._PREFIX)
+        peers = [r for r in range(self.world_size) if r != self.rank]
+        t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        _wait_for_peers(store, peers, self._PREFIX)
+        t1 = time.perf_counter()
+        buffer.connect_ranks(peers, store=store, key_prefix=self._PREFIX)
+        logger.info(
+            "nixl_ep_v2 join %d: wait_s=%.3f connect_s=%.3f",
+            self.rank,
+            t1 - t0,
+            time.perf_counter() - t1,
+        )
+        return _NixlEPV2State(
+            buffer,
+            dict(kwargs),
+            max_num_ep_ranks,
+            _nixl_ep_v2_num_sms(buffer.num_launch_sms),
+            elastic=True,
+        )
+
+    def _mode(self, ep_size: int) -> str:
+        """The kernels' mode for an EP size; equal on every rank.
+
+        Direct needs the live world in one NVLink domain, so a world larger
+        than a domain is hybrid. NIXL_EP_ADAPTIVE_MODE overrides inside one domain,
+        as at the buffer's first build.
+        """
+        state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+        assert state is not None
+        if ep_size > state.buffer.max_num_scaleup_ranks:
+            return "hybrid"
+        return os.environ.get("NIXL_EP_ADAPTIVE_MODE", "direct")
+
+    def stage_ep_size(self) -> None:
+        """Connect the joining ranks while serving goes on (prepare thread).
+
+        A shrink stages nothing: the leavers stay live until the commit.
+        """
+        with NixlEPV2All2AllManager._lock:
+            state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+            assert state is not None
+            buffer, store = state.buffer, self.tcp_store_group.store
+            target = list(range(self.world_size))
+            # Raises for a size nixl_ep_v2 cannot run (whole NVLink
+            # domains, or within the first).
+            buffer.masks_of(target)
+            joiners = sorted(
+                set(target) - set(buffer.get_connected_ranks()) - {self.rank}
+            )
+            if not joiners:
+                return
+            buffer.publish(store=store, key_prefix=self._PREFIX)
+            t0 = time.perf_counter()
+            _wait_for_peers(store, joiners, self._PREFIX)
+            t1 = time.perf_counter()
+            buffer.connect_ranks(joiners, store=store, key_prefix=self._PREFIX)
+            logger.info(
+                "nixl_ep_v2 stage %d: wait_s=%.3f connect_s=%.3f",
+                self.world_size,
+                t1 - t0,
+                time.perf_counter() - t1,
+            )
+
+    def commit_ep_size(self) -> None:
+        """Make the new world live (engine thread, between steps, outside
+        capture); a shrink then drops the leavers."""
+        with NixlEPV2All2AllManager._lock:
+            state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+            assert state is not None
+            buffer = state.buffer
+            leavers = [r for r in buffer.get_connected_ranks() if r >= self.world_size]
+            mode = self._mode(self.world_size)
+            t0 = time.perf_counter()
+            # Stage and commit together: a set_topology in between would
+            # discard the staged world.
+            # The kernels derive the mode from the staged domains.
+            buffer.stage_topology(
+                num_active_sms=state.num_sms,
+                active_ranks=list(range(self.world_size)),
+            )
+            buffer.commit_topology()
+            if leavers:
+                buffer.disconnect_ranks(leavers)
+                buffer.commit_topology()
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+            logger.info(
+                "nixl_ep_v2 commit %d %s: commit_s=%.4f",
+                self.world_size,
+                mode,
+                time.perf_counter() - t0,
+            )
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def mask_remote_ranks(self) -> Iterator[None]:
+        # Joiners only: the buffer is still its one-rank world, so the warm-up
+        # touches no peer and there is nothing to mask.
+        state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+        assert state is not None
+        assert state.buffer.get_active_ranks() == [self.rank]
+        yield
+
+    def destroy(self) -> None:
+        """Tear the buffer down on a leaving rank or at shutdown, under
+        elastic EP only (a fixed EP size keeps its shutdown as it was).
+
+        A retired manager returns at once: the newest one owns the buffer.
+        """
+        state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+        if (
+            NixlEPV2All2AllManager._newest is not self
+            or state is None
+            or not state.elastic
+        ):
+            return
+        buffer = state.buffer
+        # Go solo first: the buffer's destroy() is a barrier over the live
+        # world.
+        buffer.stage_topology(num_active_sms=state.num_sms, active_ranks=[self.rank])
+        buffer.commit_topology()
+        if peers := buffer.get_connected_ranks():
+            buffer.disconnect_ranks(peers)
+            buffer.commit_topology()
+        buffer.destroy()
+        NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state = None
+
+    @property
+    def num_sms(self) -> int:
+        """The active SMs per dispatch and combine; set by the first
+        get_handle() call."""
+        assert NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state is not None
+        return NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state.num_sms
+

+        """SMs the dispatch and combine kernels work on.
+
+        Returns:
+            The active SMs per dispatch, or None before the first
+            get_handle() call.
+
+        """
+        state = NixlEPV2All2AllManager._state
+        return None if state is None else state.num_sms
